verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a fleet of managed remote MCP servers built so users can connect from MCP clients like Cursor or Claude and "use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account". The Code Mode server covers the entire API (2,500+ endpoints) through two tools with OAuth-scoped permissions. A Skills plugin and a dedicated agent-setup hub cover major agents, and live probes confirm the OAuth-gated API server and the keyless docs server are running. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface inside the product itself (dashboard or Wrangler, rather than an external MCP client), and independent hands-on reports of natural-language operation beyond protocol-level probes.
